name: dreaming
description: Captures and consolidates Claude Code native auto memory. A UserPromptSubmit hook tells the session when the user rejected or interrupted the last turn or stated a preference, and the dreaming:note skill records the lesson with a recurrence count. A SessionStart hook decides when a pass is due and has the main session start a visible dreaming:dreamer subagent, which weighs lessons by recurrence and writes a proposal and a report to a staging directory. The dreaming:dream skill shows the diff, snapshots memory in git and applies it only on approval, asking separately before any change to the global CLAUDE.md, and a PreToolUse hook confines the subagent to staging. Requires jq.
